lines.x: 站岗嘛，我懂。军队里的新兵蛋子都得从这个位置上做起，换个地方也不例外……嗯？不是？就算你这样说，我也很难相信你有不需要他人保护的实力啊。

Here, come closer. Palm up, open—that's it. Take them, I made every one myself. Boiling the sugar is a real chore, so this is all I managed. They're nothing rare out in the world, but you understand what they're worth. Finished already? Then I've got something to ask you—and 'no comment' isn't allowed.
那个萨卡兹真是厉害，能让我毫无顾忌地跟他过招，以至于刀身到现在都还微微发烫……没那么危险，训练场里的对决能把衣服擦破都算倒霉了。对啊，术师对决，远处过招，你想的是什么？

'Doctor, I'm here.' What? Voiceprint mimicry—any war caster can do it. Not a good likeness? Then look at this, right on the tip of my blade— No playing with fire in the office? It's just an Arts simulation, I didn't actually burn your documents. You startle at the strangest things.

For the army groups, picking sides is always clear-cut: if you don't choose the Second, you become the Fourth's lackey. Nobody asks a weapon what it thinks, and my 'Shchin' used to be that weapon. Like I said, what's between me and Yevgeny isn't a personal grudge. It's not that complicated.

My comrades are all convinced I've been favored by something—that like the droopy-eyed monster in my codename, I can toy with my prey as I please and then drag it down to hell. But before the true monster, which is war, everyone is toyed with and destroyed alike. The noble and the base, all the same.
行了，我当然知道怠慢指令属于严重失职，只是没想到连你也要来指点我在远北犯的“大错”……谢谢我的帮助？我吗？又不是我有意要放过那些人，我不觉得这有什么好感谢的。

This, and this, and this too—what do they all mean? The letters crawl about like insects; how do you make sense of them? Someone always used to read this sort of thing to me. Whatever it was, Silka could recite it like a song. Maybe you could too. An audiobook? Not interested.

Brewing, sugar-making, carpentry, smithing—once we learned to walk, we learned these one by one. Off the battlefield, these were the only things we were permitted to do to pass the time and keep ourselves fed. Home-brewed liquor won't clear security, so I smuggled this bit of kvass in myself. It'll have to do.
Falls asleep standing up reading paperwork, does he. A talent for topping up your energy that fast, and not a fighter—what a waste.

Oh—a hood, robes that cover you head to foot. So you have a past you'd rather hide as well? That's fine, I understand. Styopa Razin. I'm here to establish a partnership with you. Just call me 'Viy,' same as the rest of my outfit does.
呼……呃——！咳咳，我没睡着。这位斐迪亚女士能在静默环境下让敌方自动缴械投降，我记得她也是术师吧，很有参考价值。嗯，我只看了结尾。

Feels a lot more formal than an external promotion in the First Army Group. No need to pull strings and hand out gifts, worrying the transfer order will get stuck somewhere along the line. Yeah, hard to believe, isn't it? We used to earn our bread under those pureblood Ursus types too.
还以为给个勋章维系一下合作关系就是极限了，结果现在……变得有点难办啊。再这样下去，我就必须想办法在这份信任耗尽之前好好回报你了。
Who's leading?
Mind if I bring a few more of my own along?
The battlefield. Hardly a stranger.
Focus!
Best put me where I won't catch anyone else.
Standing by.
Wide field of view. Not bad.
Any other orders?
This blade is my mother too.
It erases pain.
It snuffs out fear.
Who else is there left to pray to?
Bear witness. I've won you the victory, as promised.
Feels strange without the lads hollering at me to sing.
I'll stay behind and pull it out by the roots.
So close—!
Aboard a ship again.
Lucky for you this time. Next time some strange incantation sets your fingers alight, don't come crying.
Not bad. Do it again.
Arknights.

'Mother weeps against the red horn, Father's body slowly cools; Sister walks barefoot into the water, and the river keeps the free child.' I used to sing where my family went to every one of my comrades. Today I sing it for you. Ursus folk usually celebrate the seventh day of the year, but—happy New Year, Doctor.
I'm bored. Let's play cards, Doctor.

'Blood'? Ah, hold still—I just didn't wipe it all off. I was in a hurry to bring you this. Got some raw material from Engineering and forged it myself; I ground the edges down specially. Here, hang it on your belt, the way I do. By the way—is today your name day, or your birthday?

I once believed that to become a Freeman you had to become an executioner. But seeing you lot reminded me that the first people to fight for the Freemen's status weren't trying to set themselves apart from other Ursus at all. We only wanted to find another way forward—and we took the long way around to get there.
